letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your smile lights up my days like the desert’s golden glow, and your laughter is the sweetest melody in my heart. I’m counting the moments until we’re together again, hand‑in‑hand, dreaming of our next adventure. You’re my forever cutie, my love, my home—today and always.
poem:
In dunes or rivers, love’s our guide,  
Your sparkle makes my world collide.  
Together, dear, we dance through time,  
Two hearts entwined in perfect rhyme.
